# Navora

> Navora is a Kerala-based hyperlocal quick-commerce brand that connects customers with trusted local shops for grocery delivery. It is launching first in Manjeri, Malappuram, Kerala, India (planned soft launch 5 November 2026, official launch 28 November 2026). Navora also publishes short Malayalam explainer reels about quick commerce in India for shoppers and kirana shop owners.

Key facts:
- Official website: https://navoranow.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/navoranow/ (@navoranow)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61595473692720
- First launch location: Manjeri, Malappuram district, Kerala
- Model: local shops fulfil orders; Navora connects customers to them
- Public ordering status: check https://navoranow.com/manjeri/ for the current, verified status
